card.name: Pass marks and course assessment rules
card.fires_on: Mostly the digits or percent sign in a pass threshold such as 'at least 50%' in university course assessment rules. It also fires weakly on scattered words in student or testing text.

modes.label: Pass mark numbers
modes.description: Digits or % in a minimum-marks requirement for completing a course or assessment item.
modes.example: students must obtain at least 5<<0>>% of the marks available for each assessment

modes.label: Course and student wording
modes.description: Words like Students or dates in course outlines and assessment tables.
modes.example: <<Students>> enrolling in WEB courses MUST have ongoing

modes.label: Scattered dosing or range terms
modes.description: Weaker hits on units or words inside dose and duration ranges in drug text.
modes.example: 5 to 14 days for the treatment of ABSSSI and 5 to 10<< days>> for the treatment of CABP in adult
